body.name: executable SA-CS-ID transition system
body.construction: Encode the initial tuple \(\zeta_0\) by \(\operatorname{enc}_H\), with agendas produced by the initial-token compiler.  Repeatedly apply the first eligible relation among \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}}\), and \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\) under \(\mathfrak P_H\).  After an admitted transition, regenerate the agenda as the dependency-topologically ordered unexecuted suffix prescribed by the compiler; in particular, an ineligible token is never placed before the next eligible token.  A transition is admitted only after its finite syntactic eligibility test and exact polynomial local obligation succeed, and the successor must have smaller \(\mu_H\).  The residual relation is the only halting relation and emits either the verified rational circuit with its denominator domain or the verified global-twin box.
